sloka: दान मानादि सत्कर्रैः कुरुष्व प्रत्यनन्तरम् ।वैरम् एतत् सम् उत्स्रृज्य तव पार्श्वे स तिष्ठतु ॥४-१५-२७॥
transliteration: dāna mānādi satkarraiḥ kuruṣva pratyanantaram ।vairam etat sam utsrṛjya tava pārśve sa tiṣṭhatu ॥4-15-27॥

translations.english: 'Indeed I do not see any of your relatives comparable to him on earth. Give up enmity with him. Give him wealth. Give him respect. Keep him by your side.
